# RepoDigest regression fixture data

These are unchanged, compact inputs for product regression tests. The per-file
source commit, original path, byte length and SHA-256 are recorded in
`MANIFEST.json`. The source is the local prepared branch at
`9527870df76538cbbeb011a26fa2206e35ec7fb4`; that provenance does not imply the
branch or the underlying experiments have been publicly released.

The retained set is 259 files and 1,869,768 bytes, before this README and packaging
metadata. It includes five complete pinned source snapshots (cattrs, MarkItDown,
p-limit, minijinja and exceptiongroup), three additional source bodies, and the
exceptiongroup consumer event/traffic receipts required to verify one reused
source body. Events remain unabridged, including unfinished work.

The complete compact iniconfig observed-recipe evidence packet is also retained.
Its admission verifier binds an exact artifact inventory, including historical
failures, source archive, probes and logs. Keeping that inventory unchanged lets
the real store admission, cross-identity refusal and observed-recipe controls run
without rewriting a trust anchor. The admitted capsule/request and an older
preflight capsule/anchor are retained for positive and changed-verifier controls.

Everything below the dated packet directories is data. Tests read and hash it,
parse the retained archive, and exercise the current first-party compiler and
reader. They do not import the archived experiment builders or controllers,
execute upstream code, run containers, contact publishers, or call a model.
Repository pytest configuration excludes this directory from collection, and
the local Ruff configuration excludes these byte-bound inputs from formatting.

Only fixture locations and test setup were adapted. The source-cache fallback
test creates a temporary catalog for the one retained pinned p-limit tree,
replacing obsolete absolute study paths. Observed tests decode the retained
capsule rather than regenerating its verifier binding. Assertions and the
supported/contradicted/unknown boundaries remain unchanged.

`test_repodigest_fixtures.py` verifies the complete manifest. Source-cache,
reuse, demand, discovery, requirements, selection, comparison and observed-store
tests exercise these inputs. These regression results establish behavior on
these inputs; they are not a new campaign, independent authenticity proof,
fresh upstream verification, execution authorization or evidence of performance
savings. The original research packets remain immutable outside this integration
checkout; large databases, other sessions and campaign orchestration are omitted.
